name: peartube-monorepo
description: PearTube monorepo - P2P video streaming for desktop and mobile

scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:ebuild --prefix packages/app
scripts.desktop:stage: node -e "throw new Error('Pear OTA staging is not wired for the Electrobun desktop app yet.')"
scripts.desktop:release: node -e "throw new Error('Pear OTA release is not wired for the Electrobun desktop app yet.')"
scripts.prepare:mobile-backend: npm run schema && npm run bundle:backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/spec && npm test --prefix packages/backend && npm test --prefix packages/host
scripts.lint: npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:oxlint && npm run lint:ast:test && npm run lint:ast && eslint . --ext .js,.jsx,.ts,.tsx,.cjs --quiet
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --max-warnings 369 packages/backend/src packages/cli/src packages/cli/bin.js packages/app/app packages/app/components packages/app/lib packages/app/backend packages/host/src packages/platform/src scripts packages/spec/schema.cjs
scripts.lint:changed: npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:ast:test && npm run lint:ast && node scripts/lint-changed.mjs
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix packages/spec && npm ci --prefix packages/backend && npm ci --prefix packages/cli && npm ci --prefix packages/host && npm ci --prefix packages/platform && npm ci --prefix packages/app --legacy-peer-deps
